topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 178 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 53 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 22 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, lockable, ynbase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
